tools.name: signoz_list_alerts
tools.description: List firing/silenced/inhibited Alertmanager alert *instances* (not rule definitions) with optional alert-label and receiver filtering

limit.description: Most rows or groups to return per page. Default 50, at most 1000.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page. Default 0.

filter.description: Comma-separated alert label comparisons, each a label, one of =, !=, =~ or !~, and a quoted value. Example: alertname="HighCPU",severity="critical".

receiver.description: Regex that the receiver name must match, for example slack-.*.

tools.name: signoz_list_alert_rules
tools.description: List configured alert-rule summaries, including inactive/OK and disabled rules; use signoz_get_alert for one full definition

limit.description: Most rows or groups to return per page. Default 50, at most 1000.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page. Default 0.

tools.name: signoz_get_alert_history
tools.description: Get one configured alert rule's firing or state-transition history; defaults to six hours and paginates with data.nextCursor

timeRange.description: Relative time range, such as 30m, 1h, 6h, 24h or 3d. Ignored when both start and end are given. Default 6h.

start.description: Start time in unix milliseconds. With end, it overrides timeRange.

end.description: End time in unix milliseconds. With start, it overrides timeRange.

state.description: Only transitions to this state: inactive, pending, recovering, firing, nodata or disabled.

filter.description: Filter on the timeline's labels in SigNoz query-builder syntax, for example "severity = 'critical' AND team = 'payments'".

cursor.description: Cursor from data.nextCursor of the previous page. Repeat the same filters and range with it.

limit.description: Rows per page. Default 20, at most 10000.

tools.name: signoz_list_services
tools.description: List paginated APM services with trace activity in a time window; use field-value discovery for arbitrary service.name values in logs

timeRange.description: Relative time range, such as 30m, 1h, 6h, 24h or 3d. Ignored when both start and end are given. Default 6h.

start.description: Start time in unix milliseconds. With end, it overrides timeRange.

end.description: End time in unix milliseconds. With start, it overrides timeRange.

limit.description: Most rows or groups to return per page. Default 50, at most 1000.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page. Default 0.

tools.name: signoz_get_service_top_operations
tools.description: Return one traced service's built-in operation table, ranked by p99 with p50/p95/p99, calls, and errors; use signoz_aggregate_traces for custom aggregation

service.description: Exact traced service name, from signoz_list_services.

timeRange.description: Relative time range, such as 30m, 1h, 6h, 24h or 3d. Ignored when both start and end are given. Default 6h.

start.description: Start time in unix milliseconds. With end, it overrides timeRange.

end.description: End time in unix milliseconds. With start, it overrides timeRange.

tags.description: JSON-encoded array of tag filters, passed as a string. Omit for none.

tools.name: signoz_list_metrics
tools.description: Discover active metric names and catalog metadata such as type, temporality, and monotonicity; use signoz_query_metrics for values or trends. Set source="meter" for Cost Meter metrics

searchText.description: Only metric names that contain this text, for example cpu or http_requests.

timeRange.description: Relative time range, such as 30m, 1h, 6h, 24h or 3d. Ignored when both start and end are given. Default 1h.

start.description: Start time in unix milliseconds. With end, it overrides timeRange.

end.description: End time in unix milliseconds. With start, it overrides timeRange.

source.description: Set meter to list Cost Meter metrics. Omit for the default metrics store.

tools.name: signoz_query_metrics
tools.description: Query a known metric for scalar values, time-series trends, breakdowns, or formulas with metric-aware defaults; use signoz_list_metrics only when the metric name is unknown

metricName.description: Name of the metric, for example http_requests_total.

metricType.description: gauge, sum, histogram or exponential_histogram. Omit to have it looked up.

isMonotonic.description: Whether a sum metric only increases. Looked up when metricType is omitted.

temporality.description: cumulative, delta or unspecified. Looked up when metricType is omitted.

timeAggregation.description: Aggregation over time buckets: latest, sum, avg, min, max, count, count_distinct, rate or increase, by metric type.

spaceAggregation.description: Aggregation across series: sum, avg, min, max, count, p50, p75, p90, p95 or p99, by metric type.

groupBy.description: Field names to group by, as a comma-separated string or an array.

filter.description: Filter expression, for example "k8s.cluster.name = 'prod' AND service.name = 'frontend'".

timeRange.description: Relative time range, such as 30m, 1h, 6h, 24h or 3d. Ignored when both start and end are given. Default 1h.

start.description: Start time in unix milliseconds. With end, it overrides timeRange.

end.description: End time in unix milliseconds. With start, it overrides timeRange.

stepInterval.description: Bucket size in seconds for time_series. When omitted, SigNoz picks one.

requestType.description: time_series (default) returns one value per time bucket; scalar returns one value per series.

reduceTo.description: For scalar only: sum, count, avg, min, max, last or median.

formula.description: Formula over named queries, for example A / B * 100. The primary metric is query A.

formulaQueries.description: Extra named metric queries for formula, as a JSON array or a JSON string. Each has name and metricName.

source.description: Set meter to query Cost Meter data. Omit for the default metrics store.

tools.name: signoz_get_field_keys
tools.description: Discover available field names for filtering or grouping metrics, traces, or logs, including AI trace fields; use signoz_get_field_values after choosing a key

searchText.description: Only field names that contain this text.

metricName.description: Metric name to scope the keys, for signal metrics.

fieldDataType.description: Only fields of this data type.

tools.name: signoz_get_field_values
tools.description: Get observed values for a known metrics, traces, or logs field key; use signoz_get_field_keys when the key is unknown

name.description: Field name to list values for, for example service.name.

searchText.description: Only values that contain this text.

metricName.description: Metric name to scope the values, for signal metrics.

fieldContext.description: Context of the field, when the same name exists in more than one.

tools.name: signoz_search_logs
tools.description: Search individual log records with field filters or explicit search() across log contexts; searchText matches only body text

filter.description: Filter in SigNoz search syntax. Combine conditions with AND, OR and parentheses. Use body CONTAINS 'term' for message text, and attribute.<key> or resource.<key> to pick a context. Discover keys with signoz_get_field_keys. Example: "service.name = 'payment-svc' AND severity_text = 'ERROR'".

severity.description: Shortcut for severity_text, such as DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR or FATAL.

searchText.description: Literal text to find; it is escaped for you. searchScope picks where it matches.

timeRange.description: Relative time range, such as 30m, 1h, 6h, 24h or 3d. Ignored when both start and end are given. Default 1h.

start.description: Start time in unix milliseconds. With end, it overrides timeRange.

end.description: End time in unix milliseconds. With start, it overrides timeRange.

limit.description: Most log records to return. Default 100, at most 10000.

offset.description: Records to skip, for the next page. Default 0.

tools.name: signoz_aggregate_logs
tools.description: Return aggregate log statistics and grouped or top-N breakdowns, not individual records; use signoz_search_logs for log rows and messages

aggregation.description: Aggregation to apply: count, count_distinct, avg, sum, min, max, p50, p75, p90, p95, p99 or rate.

aggregateOn.description: Field to aggregate on. Required except for count and rate.

groupBy.description: Comma-separated field names to group by, for example service.name, severity_text.

filter.description: Filter in SigNoz search syntax. Combine conditions with AND, OR and parentheses. Use body CONTAINS 'term' for message text, and attribute.<key> or resource.<key> to pick a context. Discover keys with signoz_get_field_keys. Example: "service.name = 'payment-svc' AND severity_text = 'ERROR'".

orderBy.description: Order as '<expression> <direction>', for example count() desc.

limit.description: Most groups to return. Default 100, at most 10000.

timeRange.description: Relative time range, such as 30m, 1h, 6h, 24h or 3d. Ignored when both start and end are given. Default 1h.

start.description: Start time in unix milliseconds. With end, it overrides timeRange.

end.description: End time in unix milliseconds. With start, it overrides timeRange.

requestType.description: scalar returns one value or a grouped table over the whole range; time_series returns time-bucketed values, one series per group when grouped.

stepInterval.description: Bucket size in seconds for time_series. When omitted, SigNoz picks one.

tools.name: signoz_search_traces
tools.description: Return paginated span rows or one row per trace, including AI traces with per-trace cost and token counts, or discover trace IDs; use aggregate_traces for statistics and get_trace_details for a known trace

filter.description: Filter in SigNoz search syntax. Combine conditions with AND, OR and parentheses. Use attribute.<key>, resource.<key> or span.<key> to pick a context. Discover keys with signoz_get_field_keys. Example: "service.name = 'payment-svc' AND has_error = true".

operation.description: Only spans with this operation name.

error.description: Only spans with this error status.

minDuration.description: Shortest span duration in nanoseconds, for example 500000000 for 500ms.

timeRange.description: Relative time range, such as 30m, 1h, 6h, 24h or 3d. Ignored when both start and end are given. Default 1h.

start.description: Start time in unix milliseconds. With end, it overrides timeRange.

end.description: End time in unix milliseconds. With start, it overrides timeRange.

limit.description: Most rows to return. Default 100, at most 10000.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page. Default 0.

selectFields.description: Extra fields to return on each span row, as an array or a comma-separated string.

orderBy.description: Order as '<expression> <direction>', for example duration_nano desc.

queryType.description: builder_query searches all traces. builder_ai_query searches AI traces.

requestType.description: raw returns one row per span; trace returns one row per trace.

tools.name: signoz_aggregate_traces
tools.description: Return custom aggregate span statistics, groups, or time series; use signoz_get_service_top_operations for one service's built-in p99-ranked operation table

aggregation.description: Aggregation to apply: count, count_distinct, avg, sum, min, max, p50, p75, p90, p95, p99 or rate.

aggregateOn.description: Field to aggregate on, for example duration_nano. Required except for count and rate.

groupBy.description: Comma-separated field names to group by, for example service.name, name.

filter.description: Filter in SigNoz search syntax. Combine conditions with AND, OR and parentheses. Use attribute.<key>, resource.<key> or span.<key> to pick a context. Discover keys with signoz_get_field_keys. Example: "service.name = 'payment-svc' AND has_error = true".

error.description: Shortcut for has_error = true or false.

orderBy.description: Order as '<expression> <direction>', for example count() desc.

limit.description: Most groups to return. Default 100, at most 10000.

timeRange.description: Relative time range, such as 30m, 1h, 6h, 24h or 3d. Ignored when both start and end are given. Default 1h.

start.description: Start time in unix milliseconds. With end, it overrides timeRange.

end.description: End time in unix milliseconds. With start, it overrides timeRange.

requestType.description: scalar returns one value or a grouped table over the whole range; time_series returns time-bucketed values, one series per group when grouped.

stepInterval.description: Bucket size in seconds for time_series. When omitted, SigNoz picks one.

tools.name: signoz_get_trace_details
tools.description: For a known trace ID, return its spans, metadata, and hierarchy within a containing time window; use signoz_search_traces when the ID is unknown

timeRange.description: Relative time range, such as 30m, 1h, 6h, 24h or 3d. Ignored when both start and end are given. Default 6h. It must contain the trace.

start.description: Start time in unix milliseconds. With end, it overrides timeRange.

end.description: End time in unix milliseconds. With start, it overrides timeRange.
